PROP-5a6a79d5-asm-003.text: Post-merge blocks must have difficulty=0, nonce=0, empty ommers; deviations are protocol violations.
PROP-5a6a79d5-asm-003.assertion: forall block: header.difficulty == 0 AND header.nonce == 0x00 AND header.ommers_hash == EMPTY_OMMER_HASH

code_scope.resolution_error: Searched for: difficulty, nonce, ommers, EMPTY_OMMER_HASH. Block header field validation (difficulty, nonce, ommers_hash) is performed by consensus clients before blocks reach the execution layer. This repository handles execution only, not header validation.
